preconditions.description: The first line of input is a single integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 2e5).
The second and third lines contain exactly n integers each, representing arrays a and b.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= 10**9 for x in a) and all(1 <= x <= 10**9 for x in b)
preconditions.description: All elements in a and b are integers between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(min(sum(abs(a[i] - b[i]) for i in range(n)), sum(abs(a[i] - b[(i + 1) % n]) for i in range(n)), sum(abs(a[i] - b[i]) for i in range(n)) - abs(a[i] - b[i]) + abs(a[i] - b[j]) + abs(a[j] - b[i]) for i in range(n) for j in range(i + 1, n))))
postconditions.description: The output is the minimum possible value of the sum of absolute differences between corresponding elements of a and b, after performing at most one swap in b.
